name: agent-designer
description: The Agent Designer — a live pane plus a guided walkthrough for building a governed Agentforce agent from plain words, grounded on your real org and gated before anything deploys. A thin client over your own gateway: no credentials, no org data, and no build/authoring logic ship here.

plugins.name: agent-designer
plugins.description: A live terminal pane showing the governed build (intro -> describe -> ground -> propose -> map -> draft -> gate -> deploy) and a teaching walkthrough skill (/designer-demo). Calls your gateway via AGENT_DESIGNER_URL and grounds live on your org; nothing is hardcoded.
